story.title: Bengal CM defends decision to shift stampede injured to private hospital, cites better care
story.summary: "We moved those injured to private hospitals because we realised that the best treatment could be provided there so that there is no more loss of life. I am happy to announce that there was no death among the 25 injured in the stampede. We decided on the spot. There is nothing controversial behind this," says West Bengal CM

story.title: Deepika, Ranveer drop FIRST glimpse of second baby, announce her name
story.summary: On September 19, Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh embraced parenthood once again with the birth of their second daughter. They disclosed her name, Devi Padukone Singh, during Dussehra, sharing a heartfelt family portrait. Announcing their expanding family, they previously posted a sweet image of their first child with a pregnancy test, cleverly using evil-eye emojis to mark the joyful occasion.
